title: Application overview and the three chat modes
content: Start a new chat and choose a report. The report stays linked to that conversation. Use Ask to get report data, totals, comparisons, or lists. In Ask, optional filters in the sidebar and /variables in the message help narrow data questions. Use Help to learn how the application works and to understand the input variables available for the selected report; Help does not require filters or /variables. Use Report Terms when you want to understand an unfamiliar column name or business term shown in your report; it explains meanings rather than retrieving live values. For detailed Ask results, use the Table action when available. To switch reports, start a New chat.

title: Selecting a report
content: Select a report from the Report dropdown on the left before asking a data question, a Help question, or a Report Terms question. Each chat is linked to its selected report. Start a New chat to work with another report.

title: Ask mode: get report data
content: Use Ask to request information from the selected report, such as totals, counts, item lists, or buyer-wise breakdowns. Write the business question in plain language and send it.

title: Ask mode: insert variables
content: Only in Ask mode, type / in the message field to see variables available for the selected report. Choose a variable and enter/select its value to filter a data question.

title: Ask mode: sidebar filters
content: In Ask mode, use the optional sidebar filters under the report selector to narrow a data question. You can leave filters empty. Available filters depend on the report.

title: Help mode: variables and app guidance
content: Use Help to ask how to operate the chatbot or what an input variable means in the selected report. Help does not require sidebar filters or /variable syntax. Example: What does days mean in this report?

title: Report Terms: understand result fields
content: Use Report Terms to ask what an unfamiliar report column, label, abbreviation, or business term means. Report Terms explains concepts for the selected report; it does not list actual stored values or run a data query.

title: Starting a new chat
content: Click + New chat to start a separate conversation. Pick the appropriate report before asking report-specific questions.

title: Reviewing previous chats
content: Use Recent in the left sidebar to open earlier chats. A chat retains its selected report so it cannot be changed mid-conversation.

title: Refining an earlier data result
content: If an existing Ask result supports feedback, use its reply or modify action to describe the change you want. This can reconstruct and rerun the selected data question.

title: Viewing detailed results
content: When the assistant provides a data table, use the available table action to view the detailed breakdown. Explanations in chat summarize the business information rather than showing every record.

title: When an explanation is unclear
content: If you are unsure about a variable, use Help. If a column heading or term in a report result is unfamiliar, use Report Terms. If you want actual business values or calculations, use Ask.
